CustomField.description: Technical trigger field only. Flipped to true by a Final Approval Action once the Agreement Request's approval process has truly reached its last step - Approval_Status__c itself is set to "Approval Complete" one step earlier and does not change again, so this field exists purely to give the final step a real field change to fire on, letting GridUtility re-run the CustomApproval__c mirror with the process's actual final state. Currently wired only on the first-grid approval processes; nothing resets it back to false afterward, so it can only make the false-to-true transition once per record - reusing it for a later approval cycle (e.g. an Amendment via the future Custom Approval flow) will require explicitly resetting it to false at that cycle's submission step first.
CustomField.label: TECH Agreement Request Finalized
